# GoldMeet
> P2P used-gold matching for India. Buyers and sellers meet at a jeweller or bank that can assay gold. No escrow. No custody.

- Home: https://mjk93447-cpu.github.io/goldguideapp-site/
- Rates: https://mjk93447-cpu.github.io/goldguideapp-site/rates.html
- How it works: https://mjk93447-cpu.github.io/goldguideapp-site/how-it-works.html
- Safety: https://mjk93447-cpu.github.io/goldguideapp-site/safety.html
- FAQ: https://mjk93447-cpu.github.io/goldguideapp-site/faq.html
- Join: https://mjk93447-cpu.github.io/goldguideapp-site/join.html
- Hindi: https://mjk93447-cpu.github.io/goldguideapp-site/hi/

Fair price: city rate per 10 g (24K/22K/18K) × weight_g / 10. No making charges.
Launch city: Mumbai. Support: support@goldguideapp.com
